sources.title: Structural Guidance for Unified Joint Demosaicing and Denoising
sources.summary: Authors use frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 with a CFA/noise-conditioned SwinIR stream,trainable feature adaptation/residual fusion and auxiliary clean-mosaic output. Their stated scope uses decoded-sRGB synthetic mosaics,independent Gaussian noise,fixedRGGB and224px structural inputs;not a matched sensor-linear highISO/no-hallucination result.

sources.title: PixIE: Prompted Pixel-Space Low-Light Image Enhancement
sources.summary: Authors combine cross-scale denoising with multidepth DINOv3 features and spatially continuous per-pixel modulation;neighborhood-aware embedding and compact attention limit cost. It is a low-light enhancement study,not our validated16-bit camera-RGB JDD comparison.

our_inference: Native-grid foundation-feature fusion and spatial adaptation deserve further controlled architecture work. Existing late head already has3x3 frequency neighbors;missing peak-neighborhood access is not established. V156 isolates local supervision first;no source code/weights/data adopted or quality gain inferred from papers.
